subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Should maintainers require a live iOS/WebChat reproduction on current main or the fixed beta package before opening another source repair for this canonical no-reply issue?
rationale: The source contract and related fixes are clear, but the latest user evidence says the iOS-originated message may not reach `chat.send`, so a source-only repair could target the wrong layer without a live path.

options.title: Require live iOS proof first
options.body: Use a real or controlled iOS/WebChat setup to compare app logs, Gateway `chat.send`, `dispatchInboundMessage`, transcript, and visible reply before assigning a code fix.

options.title: Fold into restart/session work
options.body: Treat this as likely part of the restart/session ownership family and handle it under the open boot-session tracker if maintainers believe the native app evidence is not distinct.

options.title: Queue a speculative source repair
options.body: Let automation attempt a Gateway/iOS fix from source hints despite the unresolved reproduction gap, accepting a higher chance of a wrong-layer PR.

recommendation.title: Require live iOS proof first
recommendation.body: Use a real or controlled iOS/WebChat setup to compare app logs, Gateway `chat.send`, `dispatchInboundMessage`, transcript, and visible reply before assigning a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent iOS transport and Gateway chat history on the exact files involved in the current evidence.
